fullContentHtml:
Bihar ITI CAT Counselling/ Choice Filling 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Board (BCECEB) has released the Counselling/ Choice Filling for the Bihar ITI Competitive Admission Test 2026. Online Counselling/ Choice Filling process for Bihar ITI CAT Online Form 2026 has stated on from 22 June 2026 and candidates can online counselling/ choice filling till 01 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bihar ITI CAT Online Counselling/ Choice Filling 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 16 March 2026
  • Last Date : 27 April 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 April 2026
  • Correction Date : 29-30 April 2026
  • Exam Date : 17 May 2026
  • Admit Card : 10 May 2026
  • Answer Key : Available Soon
  • Result / Rank Card : 04 June 2026
  • Counselling Start : 22 June 2026
  • Counselling Last Date : 01 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EBC Candidates : Rs. 750/-
  • SC, ST Candidates : Rs. 100/-
  • PH Candidate : Rs. 430/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

What is Bihar ITI CAT Counselling/ Choice Filling 2026?

Bihar ITI CAT Counselling/ Choice Filling 2026 is a government exam related notification. Complete details including important dates, fee, eligibility and links are provided above.

What is the last date to apply?

The last date to apply is 27 April 2026.

Where can I find the official website?

The official website is: https://bceceboard.bihar.gov.in/

Click on the relevant link in the Important Links section above or visit the official website directly.
